preserve_before_recovery: build/electron-sidecar (entire tree: source snapshot, work TOCs/PYZ/pkg, partial notice-inputs, spec, log and failed report)
recovery: ROOT must preserve the whole failed engine/work tree, commit corrected lock/source identity, and explicitly release one numbered recovery through the existing supervisor. Builder must capture a fresh source snapshot with the corrected lock; old failed snapshot remains unchanged. No automatic retry.
notice_limit: Original CPython static-vendor and Electron renderer notice-source gaps remain recorded. This lock correction establishes closure version consistency, not distribution/clinical readiness.
